query:
SELECT 
  SUM(valorContabil) as total_faturado_contabil,
  SUM(valorFaturar) as total_a_faturar,
  SUM(valorTotal) as total_valor_total,
  COUNT(*) as total_itens
FROM sales_orders 
WHERE SUBSTRING(dataEmissao, 1, 10) >= '2026-03-01' 
  AND SUBSTRING(dataEmissao, 1, 10) <= '2026-03-31'
  AND estadoConfiguravel NOT IN ('AMOSTRA', 'BONIFICAÇÃO', 'CANCELADO')
  AND estadoConfiguravel IS NOT NULL
  AND estadoItem != 'Digitação';
